data_fields.name: stat_damage_table
data_fields.donor_constant: STR table: one step per 2 STR to 22, per 3 at 23-28, per 2 at 29-32, per 1 at 33-34, per 4 from 35; DEX table starts at 1 at DEX 15

data_fields.name: weapon_roll_max
data_fields.donor_constant: weapon roll 1..max, max chosen by target size (small or large)

data_fields.name: armour_defence_divisor
data_fields.donor_constant: class defence roll limit = (10 - AC) / 2 for Knight; Wizard /2 or /5 with SOFT_AC

data_fields.name: magic_repeat_step_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 ms per step; each step cuts 3 percent (20 steps, 2000 ms window, 60 percent floor)

best_idea: Resolve each swing as one server roll with a fixed miss band and a fixed hit band, then a stat comparison, then flat armour reduction, and treat zero-or-less after reduction as a miss.
decision_why: Keep the shape (fixed bands on one roll, flat armour soak, zero after reduction is a miss) in src/fight/hit.ts with Frankendom's own curve and constants; the donor's 5-95 percent comment does not match its code, and its magic limiter uses wall-clock time, so neither is copied.
acceptance: A server test with a seeded dice source runs 10,000 duel swings per attacker and defender pair and asserts natural 1 never hits, natural 20 always hits, zero-or-less damage after reduction records a miss, and the same seed replays the same swing list.
